title: Test Coverage Phase 2
description: Expand test coverage to 163 untested engines and 63 untested cadence functions. QA-MS13 identified 95% engine test gap and 94% cadence test gap. Safety-critical engines first.

units.title: Engine Test Framework

steps.instruction: Create test harness for engine unit tests (mock registry data, standard fixtures)
Create helper for AtomicValue assertions (value within uncertainty, correct units)
Create material/tool/machine test fixtures from real registry data

exit_conditions: Test harness importable by all engine test files

units.title: Core Manufacturing Engine Tests

steps.instruction: Write tests for CuttingForceEngine (Kienzle model, edge cases)
Write tests for ToolLifeEngine (Taylor equation, cliff warnings)
Write tests for SpeedFeedEngine (material coverage, tool normalization)
Write tests for ThermalEngine, DeflectionEngine, SurfaceFinishEngine

exit_conditions: 6 core manufacturing engines have unit tests

units.title: Safety Engine Tests

steps.instruction: Write tests for SafetyEngine S(x) scoring (hard block, edge cases)
Write tests for CoolantValidationEngine (all brackets, MQL, dry titanium)
Write tests for 5-axis engines (WorkEnvelope, RTCP, Singularity)

exit_conditions: All safety-critical engines have comprehensive tests

steps.instruction: Write tests for ThreadEngine (339 specs, stripping calculation)
Write tests for EDM engines (WireEDM, SinkEDM, WhiteLayer)
Write tests for PostProcessorEngine (6 controller dialects, canned cycles)
Write tests for StabilityEngine (SLD, chatter detection with FFT)
Write tests for KnowledgeQueryEngine (TF-IDF scoring, stop words)
Write tests for ComplianceEngine (6 regulatory frameworks)
Write tests for HookEngine and HookExecutor (event routing, phase chains)
Write tests for AgentExecutor and SwarmExecutor (orchestration modes)

units.title: Remaining Cadence Function Tests

steps.instruction: Identify 63 untested cadence functions (REM-MS5 covered 40 of 103)
Write tests for manufacturing cadences (pressure zone, auto-recalc)
Write tests for intelligence cadences (telemetry, adaptive)
Write tests for orchestration cadences (heartbeat, swarm health)

exit_conditions: All 103 cadence functions have at least basic coverage
